method: Actual in-app browser, controls operated through the UI; qa=1 uses separate saves.

checks.stoneAge: Five active resource icons; citizen carrying and delivery observed.
checks.industry: Six active resources; native citizen has 50/50 HP; native OilRig built for 100 wood.
checks.oilCrew: One citizen gives 1/6 crew and +0.75 oil/second; oil rose from 400 to 671.
checks.unload: UI action returned crew to 0/6, free citizens to 5, rate to +0.00 and oil remained 671.
checks.models: Corrected industrial citizen Near at zoom 80 and Far at zoom 45 visibly grounded and proportioned; source pose tests passed separately.
checks.audio: All 15 diagnostic codec samples decoded; HERC selection produced Originalaufnahme abgespielt, effectPlays=1, failed=[].
checks.handoff: Fresh normal start menu loaded with all 15 starting epochs, original assets ready, no warning/error console entries. Existing user game preserved.

limits: Focused visual/function checks, not a full-game acceptance test. No rendered FPS measurement or physical multi-computer/NAT test.
